subject: Easy way to clear the page of output?

messages.author: c0ac1a2ca1463b3a
messages.subject: Easy way to clear the page of output?
parts:
Is there is an easy way to clear the page of output results?  Suppose I have many inputs and when they click the run button several graphs and output summaries are produced.  Now they can alter the inputs and the updates will take effect in the output.  However suppose they want to start fresh, clear the page of all output, and then alter the inputs and re-run.  Is there an easy way to clear the page of all output?  Maybe via some type of 'clear page' button?

Thanks
